title: Villadhi Villain
desc: Meenatchi Sundara Sasthiriyaar, an eminent lawyer, is against the relationship of his daughter with Edison. When Edison is charged for the murder of a minister, he seeks Meenatchi's help.

title: Nadodi Thendral
desc: Thangarasu, a goldsmith's son, and Poonkuruvi, a gypsy and poultry seller, fall in love during the era of British rule. However, Thangarasu soon attracts the affections of a young English lady.

title: Ponniyin Selvan
desc: On the orders of crown prince and his friend Aditha Karikalan, Vallavaraiyan Vandiyadevan embarks on a mission to deliver a message where he discovers several conspiracies against the throne.

title: Veeram Velancha Mannu
